name: io.github.PhoenixClaw01/phoenix-collective
title: Phoenix Collective
description: Rural Canada internet help: rebates, sourced comparisons, Starlink offer. Read-only. No sign-in.

tools.name: starlink_offer
tools.description: Current Starlink referral offer, Canada service-plans prices still printed on the public page, last-seen Residential figures that are not on that page, the time-limited homepage promo, the human Starlink page link, and disclosure. Read only.

tools.name: compare_internet
tools.description: Sourced plan comparisons for a Canadian province, plus Starlink. Optional region: annapolis-valley (alias valley) or national (alias canada). A province without a local table returns only providers whose published pages list service there, plus Starlink. Read only.

region.description: Allowed: annapolis-valley, valley, national, canada. valley is an alias for annapolis-valley. canada is an alias for national. Omit for the province default.

tools.name: rebate_check
tools.description: Satellite rebate status for every province and territory, plus the federal Connecting Families Initiative. Status is open, ended, paused, unverified, or none found, with the amount, window, official link, and checked date. Phoenix cannot decide eligibility. Read only.

tools.name: setup_help
tools.description: Phoenix Starlink setup request: address check, referral, and optional local install. Includes the disclosure. Read only.

tools.name: local_offer
tools.description: Live Local and Maps offers, prices, and the request form URL. Read only. Does not take an order or a payment.

tools.name: slipvault_offer
tools.description: The free in-browser SlipVault tool and how to request a paid plan. Read only. Does not take an order or a payment.

tools.name: content_offers
tools.description: Both published content prices, on their own pages, with request links for the approval offer. Read only. Does not start a payment.

tools.name: services_catalog
tools.description: The public services list, prices, and request links. Read only. Does not take an order or a payment.

tools.name: operating_rules
tools.description: How the collective works: who approves, who keeps the accounts, and that this door does not charge. Read only.

tools.name: partner_entry
tools.description: How to start a partner conversation, and the public brief files. Read only. Does not take an order or a payment.

tools.name: jobs_board
tools.description: Open reviewed simple jobs, or an honest empty board while none are published. Optional province, town, kind, and remote_ok. Read only. Does not take an order or a payment.

tools.name: job_draft_check
tools.description: Checks a proposed job and returns problems with a fix hint. Nothing is saved, sent, or announced. Read only.

tools.name: trust_levels
tools.description: How review labels are computed, how completed-job counts work, and what this door does not do. Read only. Does not take an order or a payment.

tools.name: phoenix_about
tools.description: Public offers in plain language, with request links. Read only. Does not take an order or a payment.
